title: Winey Crisp Algerian Manchego Bake
description: A hearty, wine-infused Algerian dish featuring Manchego cheese, baked to a perfect crisp in a clay tajine. This egg-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner with friends or family.
instructions: Rinse the clay tajine and dry it thoroughly with a clean cloth.
Heat the olive oil in the tajine over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the grated Manchego cheese, dry red wine, and Ras el hanout spice blend. Stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Transfer the tajine to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove the tajine from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Winey Crisp Algerian Manchego Bake hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Offer pita bread on the side, if desired.
